info.description: Single-company HRMS. Cookie sessions; send credentials and X-CSRF-Token on state-changing requests. All such requests require an allowed Origin header. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; instants include a timezone. Monetary values are decimal strings in INR. Lists return items and meta.
